name: rsi_reversal_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, sharp 2-minute directional moves push RSI(24) into extreme territory (<30 or >70) as stop-loss cascades or momentum-chasing algos overshoot fair value. When this exhaustion occurs while the index is displaced from its 30-minute EMA — meaning price has deviated from where VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms are anchored — market makers absorb the terminal flow and resting limit orders accumulate. Within 30-90 seconds, the overshoot reverses as VWAP-tracking algorithms and gamma-hedging desks push the index back toward the 30-minute mean, creating a 10-20 spot point bounce (or fade) that option buyers can capture at ATM delta ~0.5.
core_signal_oneliner: 2-minute RSI below 30 (or above 70) while price is displaced below (or above) the 30-min EMA, signaling overshoot reversal back toward the intraday mean
